fields.description: The field service job this report documents the outcome of.

fields.label: Report Type
fields.options:
Service Report
Inspection Report
Preventive Maintenance Report

fields.description: Sequential version number, incremented each time the report is regenerated.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Draft
Generated
Customer Review
Customer Signed
Verified
Submitted

fields.description: The customer who received the service covered by this report.

fields.description: The operating company responsible for delivering the service.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: The project this service work is billed or tracked against.
fields.label: Project

fields.description: The physical site or location where the service was performed.
fields.label: Customer Site

fields.description: Timestamp when the report was first generated from the job snapshot.
fields.label: Generated On

fields.description: Timestamp when a supervisor verified the report contents.
fields.label: Verified On

fields.label: Submitted On
